item.title: Bears QB Caleb Williams 'on track' for Week 6 return
item.description: Caleb Williams and the Chicago Bears are optimistic he turned the corner from hamstring injury recovery to full acceleration this week.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Caleb Williams and the Chicago Bears are optimistic he turned the corner from hamstring injury recovery to full acceleration this week. But head coach Ben Johnson didn't want to declare Williams ready to go Friday. Williams missed three games and said his hamstring was torn in the Week 2 loss to the Minnesota Vikings. "I'm hopeful we'll have more clarity at the end of the day today," Johnson said Friday after practice. "He looked good yesterday for one practice, but we got to be able to stack a few back-to-back. He got some good work in on Wednesday, it's part of the plan and he's on track right now." Williams joined defensive backs Kyler Gordon (calf) and Tyrique Stevenson Jr. (hip) as questionable to face the host Atlanta Falcons (2-3) on Sunday. Williams would stand to become the third starter in the past four games for the Bears (3-2), who are in a three-way tie for second place in the NFC North behind undefeated Minnesota (5-0). Case Keenum started Week 3 and defeated the Philadelphia Eagles before Tyson Bagent got the call for the past two games. Williams met with media on Thursday for the first time since his injury and shared the severity in a terse tone. Johnson said Friday that Williams showed no outward frustration around the team and was dealing with a novel set of circumstances. "I honestly didn't feel any frustration from him. He was just in a bit of new territory, he's never been in the training room this much or taken a backseat in the quarterback room," Johnson said. "His main focus was asking for guidance on how to best support the team and serve as a captain while sidelined. The only eagerness he showed was wanting to get back on the field and help the guys win." Running back Kyle Monangai (toe, thumb), linebackers T.J. Edwards (hamstring) and Keyshaun Elliott (quadricep) as well as defensive lineman Dayo Odeyingbo (quadricep) were ruled out against Atlanta. --Field Level Media

item.title: Avenue Capital emerges as frontrunner for stake in Serie A media rights venture, sources say
item.description: Private equity firm Avenue Capital has emerged as the leading bidder for a minority stake in the company that will hold the international media rights of Italy's top soccer league Serie A, two people with knowledge of the matter told Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Elvira Pollina
item.content:encoded: Private equity firm Avenue Capital has emerged as the leading bidder for a minority stake in the company that will hold the international media rights of Italy's top soccer league Serie A, two people with knowledge of the matter told Reuters. Serie A is exploring the sale of a stake in a company that will hold its international broadcasting, sponsorship and betting rights and last month it received final bids from private equity firms . Serie A clubs met on Friday for an initial review of the bids, the two people said. New York-based Avenue Capital is targeting a stake of 10% in the media company for €320 million, the people said, which would put the overall valuation of the venture at €3.2 billion. Avenue is in the lead despite the fact that some rival bidders have offered to pay more because its offer is structured as a common equity investment, without the protections on future cash flows sought by some of the competitors, one of the two people said. The person added that Carlyle and Nextalia, which teamed up to submit a joint bid, had offered around €650 million for a stake of roughly 17%, valuing the venture at about €3.75 billion. The Avenue Capital offer will be examined more closely in the coming weeks by the clubs, the people said, cautioning that there is no final decision on the matter. Avenue Capital and Serie A declined to comment. Carlyle and Nextalia were not immediately available to comment. Any deal requires the backing of at least 14 of the league's 20 clubs. Home to Inter Milan, AC Milan and Juventus (JUVE.MI) , the Italian league has been struggling in recent years to sell its media rights abroad, as broadcasters' interest dwindled due to a crowded fixture list dominated by the expanded UEFA Champions League and the popularity of England's Premier League. The Serie A international media unit generates sales of around €250 million a year, a fraction of those yielded by Premier League and Spain's LaLiga, according to data from European soccer body UEFA.

item.title: Nearly 12,000 California residents bought EVs using state rebate program
item.description: California said on Friday nearly 12,000 residents bought electric vehicles using rebates under a new $270 million program funded by the state and automakers.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: California said on Friday nearly 12,000 residents bought electric vehicles using rebates under a new $270 million program funded by the state and automakers. Still, overall EV sales have fallen both in California and nationwide as President Donald Trump's administration has removed federal incentives for EVs. EV sales are up globally. The program for California residents buying their first EV was signed into law by Governor Gavin Newsom in July and offers $3,500 rebates on new EVs with retail prices of up to $50,000 and a $1,750 rebate for used EVs costing no more than $25,000. California said EVs accounted for 18% of all state sales through September 30 compared to 23% last year and 25% in 2024. Tesla vehicles account for more than half of EVs sold in California. The program is still offering rebates through participating automakers, including Ford (F.N) , GM (GM.N) , Honda (7267.T) , Hyundai (005380.KS) , Kia, Toyota (7203.T) and its Lexus brand, Lucid, Nissan (7201.T) , Rivian (RIVN.O) , Subaru <9778.T>, and Volvo. There are no funds remaining for Tesla models under the program, which includes $135.5 million in state funding and $135.5 million from participating automakers. The federal government has dropped support for EVs and charging programs. Trump signed legislation in 2025 that killed the federal $7,500 EV tax credit and the federal $4,000 used EV credit, which has reduced US sales. California's previous rebate program ended in 2023 and spent $1.49 billion to subsidize 586,000 EV purchases over a decade. Trump has taken aim at EVs on a number of fronts, including signing legislation in June 2025 against California's rules adopted by nearly a dozen other states that aim to phase out new gasoline-powered cars by 2035. California has sued to challenge the procedure used to reverse the landmark EV rules. The administration has finalized other changes that will save automakers billions of dollars in purchasing credits from Tesla (TSLA.O) and others to meet prior regulatory requirements.

item.title: US appeals court blocks class actions over Tesla's self-driving claims
item.description: A US appeals court threw out on Friday an order allowing Tesla customers in California to pursue class action claims accusing the electric vehicle maker of misleading them about the capabilities of its full self-driving technology.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded: A US appeals court threw out on Friday an order allowing Tesla (TSLA.O) customers in California to pursue class action claims accusing the electric vehicle maker of misleading them about the capabilities of its full self-driving technology. In its ruling , a three-judge panel of the San Francisco-based 9th US Circuit Court of Appeals said there were too many individualized questions about what buyers actually saw before making a purchase, and so they could not sustain their lawsuit as a class action. The appeals court decision is a win for now for Tesla, which had urged the appeals court to vacate orders by a California judge last year certifying three sets of classes. The ruling means the thousands of California buyers the lower court had grouped together cannot, for now, pursue their claims jointly in a single case. The ruling is not on the merits of the plaintiffs' lawsuit alleging false advertising, and the case remains pending. The plaintiffs contend Tesla is misrepresenting its vehicles' hardware capabilities for full self-driving, convincing customers to pay extra money for software that they say does not work. In a statement, the plaintiffs' lawyers said "we think the panel did not fully appreciate the unique circumstances here, and the importance of the hardware statement to Tesla's marketing campaign." Tesla did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Tesla has denied the plaintiffs' claims. In the underlying case, US District Judge Rita Lin last year [USN:L1N3UB0FD TEXT:"ruled"] that thousands of prospective buyers were likely exposed to Tesla's claim on its website that vehicles sold from October 2016 to the present contained hardware needed for full self-driving capability. But the appeals court panel — Circuit Judges Ronald Gould, Jay Bybee and Daniel Bress — said the plaintiffs could not show that all class members had been exposed to the allegedly false statement. The US Chamber of Commerce filed a court brief in support of Tesla and urged the appeals court to strike the class certification orders. The business advocate said the underlying ruling "threatens to substantially increase the costs to businesses and consumers of overbroad and meritless class proceedings."

item.title: US arms firm Anduril could make interceptors in Europe, executive says
item.description: US defence firm Anduril could eventually manufacture its newly unveiled Steelfin interceptor missiles in Europe, a company executive said this week, as governments aim to expand air-defence production after global conflicts highlighted shortages of interceptor missiles.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US defence firm Anduril could eventually manufacture its newly [USN:L6N45Y03E TEXT:"unveiled Steelfin interceptor"] missiles in Europe, a company executive said this week, as governments aim to expand air-defence production after global conflicts highlighted shortages of interceptor missiles. "I certainly hope that something like Steelfin could become a capability that we engage with both the Polish customer and industry," Brian Moran, Anduril's vice president for Europe, told Reuters on Monday. "We would definitely consider engaging European partners and customers on this capability." Steelfin is due to undergo flight testing in 2027, according to Anduril. Wars in Ukraine and the Gulf have strained stocks of air-defence interceptor missiles and caused delivery delays. Moran said Anduril saw Steelfin as a complementary system that could provide a more affordable interceptor alongside existing missile-defence systems like the Patriot and others. The company is already in talks to establish production in Poland of its Barracuda-500 cruise missile, and Moran said that experience could open the door to additional manufacturing projects. "We're having a very good experience with our industry partner here, PGZ," he said, adding that discussions were also under way with the defence ministry and other government agencies. PGZ is Poland's state-owned arms group. Poland, one of [USN:L8N3LX0B6 TEXT:"NATO's top defence spenders"] relative to the size of its economy, is seeking to expand domestic arms production and [USN:L8N42W1SI TEXT:"reduce reliance"] on foreign suppliers. Moran said talks with PGZ, its WZL-2 unit and the government were focused on balancing local production with delivery speed and Poland's specific military requirements. Asked about growing calls in Europe for defence-industrial sovereignty, Moran said the term could mean different things, from security of supply and maintenance capabilities to control over software upgrades and future modifications. "Sovereignty has a cost. There's a cost to localisation. There's cost in terms of timing and just schedule. And those need to be considered in light of the threats that Europe collectively is facing." While governments also want economic benefits from defence spending, the military outcome is most important, he said, adding that greater localisation can come with additional costs and longer timelines.

item.title: UE vai propor restrições às importações de outros setores chineses, diz chefe da UE
item.description: A Comissão Europeia proporá restrições às importações da China que vão além das medidas de salvaguarda acordadas com Pequim para reduzir pela metade as remessas de carros híbridos chineses, afirmou nesta sexta-feira a presidente da Comissão Europeia, Ursula von der Leyen.
item.dc:creator: Philip Blenkinsop
item.content:encoded: A Comissão Europeia proporá restrições às importações da China que vão além das medidas de salvaguarda acordadas com Pequim para reduzir pela metade as remessas de carros híbridos chineses, afirmou nesta sexta-feira a presidente da Comissão Europeia, Ursula von der Leyen. Von der Leyen disse em uma coletiva de imprensa após uma cúpula da UE que o acordo firmado com a China não resolveria o desequilíbrio estrutural. O déficit comercial de bens da UE com a China está em mais de 1 bilhão de euros por dia. “E é por isso que precisamos agir”, disse ela. “Nossas indústrias pediram medidas, nós as ouvimos e vamos responder, incluindo mais algumas medidas de salvaguarda.” Ela afirmou que isso contou com o apoio claro dos líderes da UE. O presidente francês, Emmanuel Macron, disse aos repórteres após a cúpula que a UE deveria se concentrar em medidas relacionadas a produtos químicos, plásticos e ferroligas. Von der Leyen disse que acolhia com satisfação um documento franco-alemão publicado no mês passado, que propunha que a União Europeia reforçasse sua economia por meio da adoção de uma nova medida de ação rápida para retaliar países que a prejudicam. Ela disse que a Comissão desenvolveria um novo instrumento para limitar rapidamente o acesso ao mercado único da UE, sempre que isso fosse do interesse do bloco. Ela também disse que o braço executivo da UE apresentaria, em dezembro, uma proposta para um novo instrumento que limitasse a dependência das empresas da UE de fontes únicas para determinados suprimentos críticos. A Comissão Europeia também proporia um “mecanismo de solidariedade” para ajudar países ou setores que estejam sujeitos a coação ou retaliação de fora da UE.

item.title: GRANOS Soja toca mínimo de siete semanas y maíz baja por previsión de clima seco en Medio Oeste
item.description: Los futuros de la soja estadounidense cayeron el viernes a un mínimo de siete semanas, mientras que los del maíz se acercaron a uno de dos meses, ya que se prevé que el tiempo seco en el Medio Oeste durante la próxima semana acelere el avance de la cosecha.
item.dc:creator: Karl Plume
item.content:encoded: Los futuros de la soja estadounidense cayeron el viernes a un mínimo de siete semanas, mientras que los del maíz se acercaron a uno de dos meses, ya que se prevé que el tiempo seco en el Medio Oeste durante la próxima semana acelere el avance de la cosecha. Los futuros del trigo cayeron a un mínimo de dos meses, encaminándose hacia su séptima caída semanal consecutiva, ya que las condiciones meteorológicas favorables para la siembra de los cultivos de invierno en las Llanuras ejercieron presión sobre los precios. Las ventas técnicas y la liquidación de posiciones largas antes del fin de semana ejercieron presión sobre los mercados de cultivos, a pesar de los retrasos en las labores del campo en muchas zonas esta semana debido a las lluvias generalizadas. "Hoy deberían persistir las lluvias en el noreste del Medio Oeste y en el extremo sur de las Llanuras, pero se espera un tiempo más seco en todas las zonas este fin de semana y a principios de la próxima semana. Esto favorecerá la cosecha de maíz y soja, así como la siembra de trigo de invierno", dijeron los meteorólogos de Vaisala en una nota. Los contratos de soja de noviembre de la Bolsa de Chicago bajaban 3,25 centavos, a 12,5975 dólares el bushel, a las 1740 GMT, tras haber caído antes a su nivel más bajo desde el 27 de agosto. El contrato de referencia se encaminaba hacia una caída semanal del 2,5%, a pesar de la renovada demanda por parte de China, el principal importador. El Departamento de Agricultura de Estados Unidos (USDA) confirmó el viernes ventas privadas por un total de 558.000 toneladas métricas de soja estadounidense a China, lo que eleva el total confirmado a 1,358 millones de toneladas en los últimos tres días. El contrato de maíz para diciembre caía 4 centavos, a 4,74 dólares el bushel, tras situarse a solo 3 centavos del mínimo de dos meses de la semana pasada, cuando el USDA elevó inesperadamente su previsión de cosecha en Estados Unidos. El contrato cerraba la semana con una caída de alrededor del 1%, la tercera baja consecutiva. El contrato de trigo para diciembre de la CBOT bajaba a 6,59 dólares por bushel, con una pérdida de 11 centavos en la jornada. El contrato, que ha bajado alrededor de un 1,8 % en la semana, no ha registrado una subida semanal desde finales de agosto, a pesar de las preocupaciones sobre los suministros de Rusia y Ucrania en medio de los continuos ataques a buques en el mar Negro.

item.title: FAA bars unauthorized drones along US-Mexico border, citing security concerns
item.description: The Federal Aviation Administration said on Friday it is barring unauthorized drones along the US border with Mexico as the government steps up efforts to address concerns about illegal cross-border drug shipments.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The Federal Aviation Administration said on Friday it is barring unauthorized drones along the US border with Mexico as the government steps up efforts to address concerns about illegal cross-border drug shipments. The temporary flight restriction bars any unauthorized drone activity up to 400 feet (122 m) above ground level and extends one nautical mile north of the US-Mexico border. In April, the FAA and Pentagon signed an agreement allowing the government's use of a high-energy laser counter-drone system along the southern US border with Mexico to address drone threats. The Pentagon has said there are more than 1,000 drone incursions along the US-Mexico border each month. US security officials have increasingly expressed alarm about the use of drones by Mexican cartels to drop drug packages or surveil trafficking routes. "By restricting unauthorized drone activity, we are giving commanders greater awareness, greater decision space, and more options to defend the homeland," said Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, adding that the military "will shoot down any cartel drone that threatens America’s sovereignty.” In February, the FAA said it would halt all flights for 10 days at the El Paso, Texas, airport because of the use of the Pentagon laser system by Customs and Border Protection without completion of an FAA safety review. CBP is part of the Homeland Security Department. The FAA lifted the El Paso shutdown order after about eight hours following the White House's intervention. The US military days later shot down a CBP drone with the laser-based system, leading the FAA to expand an area in which flights were barred around Fort Hancock, Texas. DHS vowed closer communication with other agencies after the incident. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said on Friday that the restrictions "will help counter cartel drone threats, protect our personnel, and strengthen security in the airspace above the border." Earlier this year, media reports said drones were seen over Fort McNair in Washington where Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Hegseth live. In May, FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford told Reuters the counter-drone system is used only along southern border and is not used at Fort McNair, which is close to Reagan Washington National Airport.

item.title: La portavoz de la Casa Blanca deja el cargo, según un responsable
item.description: La secretaria de prensa de la Casa Blanca, Katie Zacharia, fue despedida de su cargo, según informó el viernes un funcionario de la Casa Blanca, después de que el presidente Donald Trump afirmara que le había pedido que se replanteara seguir en el puesto tras el escrutinio público.
item.dc:creator: Trevor Hunnicutt, Jasper Ward, Nandita Bose
item.content:encoded: La secretaria de prensa de la Casa Blanca, Katie Zacharia, fue despedida de su cargo, según informó el viernes un funcionario de la Casa Blanca, después de que el presidente Donald Trump afirmara que le había pedido que se replanteara seguir en el puesto tras el escrutinio público. "Le dije: 'Creo que es mejor que seas feliz, y no estoy seguro de que puedas llegar a ser feliz en todo esto'. No hay nada fácil en todo esto", declaró Trump a periodistas al salir de la Casa Blanca. Añadió: "Le dije con toda sinceridad: 'Si yo fuera tú, me lo replantearía… piénsalo. Pero yo me lo replantearía'". Fox News, citando a un funcionario de la Casa Blanca, informó más tarde de que Zacharia estaba "dejando" el cargo de secretaria de prensa. Zacharia asumió el cargo el lunes y ofreció su primera rueda de prensa en la Casa Blanca el martes. Había declarado que recibió una llamada el miércoles pasado sobre el puesto de secretaria de prensa y que el viernes pasado le ofrecieron el cargo para suceder a Karoline Leavitt. Trump anunció posteriormente su nombramiento. En su comunicado, la describió como abogada. Durante la última semana, se ha cuestionado si Zacharia, licenciada por la Facultad de Derecho de la Universidad Pepperdine de California, había superado realmente el examen de acceso a la abogacía, lo que la convertiría en abogada. El viernes, durante una entrevista concedida el jueves a Fox News, Zacharia afirmó que no había aprobado el examen de acceso a la abogacía. Anthony Scaramucci ocupó el cargo de director de comunicaciones durante 10 días en la primera administración de Trump.

item.title: El déficit fiscal de EEUU sube a 1,99 billones de dólares en el año, el mayor en un lustro
item.description: El déficit presupuestario de Estados Unidos aumentó 217.000 millones de dólares, a 1,99 billones de dólares, en el ejercicio fiscal de 2026, impulsado por las devoluciones de aranceles y el gasto récord para pagar la deuda, lo que supone el mayor débito en cinco años, según cifras del Departamento del Tesoro publicadas el viernes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El déficit presupuestario de Estados Unidos aumentó 217.000 millones de dólares, a 1,99 billones de dólares, en el ejercicio fiscal de 2026, impulsado por las devoluciones de aranceles y el gasto récord para pagar la deuda, lo que supone el mayor débito en cinco años, según cifras del Departamento del Tesoro publicadas el viernes. Los resultados del ejercicio finalizado el 30 de septiembre, el primero completo del segundo mandato del presidente Donald Trump, contrastan con el déficit de 1,78 billones de dólares del año fiscal 2025. El déficit de 2026 es el mayor desde los 2,77 billones de dólares del ejercicio fiscal 2021, cuando el gasto aumentó por las ayudas relacionadas con la pandemia del COVID-19, y es el tercero más alto de la historia. Los ingresos totales del ejercicio fiscal 2026 alcanzaron un récord de 5,40 billones de dólares, lo que supone un aumento de 169.000 millones de dólares, o un 3%, respecto de los 5,24 billones del ejercicio fiscal 2025. Los gastos del ejercicio fiscal 2026 también alcanzaron un récord de 7,40 billones de dólares, lo que supone un aumento de 386.000 millones de dólares, o un 6%, respecto de los 7,01 billones del ejercicio fiscal anterior. Los gastos en concepto de servicio de la deuda ascendieron a un máximo histórico de 1,36 billones de dólares, es decir, un aumento de 144.000 millones de dólares, o un 12%. El pago de la deuda solo queda eclipsada por la Seguridad Social y los gastos combinados de Medicare y Medicaid. La deuda total de Estados Unidos superó la barrera de los 40 billones de dólares hace aproximadamente dos meses. Otro factor que contribuyó al aumento del déficit fue una caída de 22.000 millones de dólares de los ingresos netos por aranceles, tras una sentencia de la Corte Suprema de este año que anuló una gran parte de los aranceles que Trump había impuesto durante su primer año en el cargo. El fallo provocó devoluciones de aranceles por valor de 145.000 millones de dólares durante el año, lo que se tradujo en un descenso del 11% en los ingresos netos por aranceles, a unos 173 000 millones de dólares. Un funcionario del Tesoro de Estados Unidos dijo que el departamento había calculado una ratio estimada de déficit respecto del PIB del 6,2% para el ejercicio fiscal 2026, pero se negó a revelar qué estimación del PIB se había utilizado. La cifra contrasta con el 5,8% de 2025. En septiembre, el último mes del ejercicio fiscal 2026, el Tesoro registró un déficit de 27.000 millones de dólares, que se compara con el superávit de 198.000 millones de dólares del año anterior.

item.title: Air Canada, United Airlines to expand Canada-US network with new summer routes
item.description: Air Canada on Friday said it will launch new trans-border routes in partnership with United Airlines for summer 2027, expanding non-stop access to US destinations and enhancing connections across the country.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Air Canada (AC.TO) on Friday said it will launch new trans-border routes in partnership with United Airlines (UAL.O) for summer 2027, expanding non-stop access to US destinations and enhancing connections across the country. The carrier will launch services from Toronto to Louisville, Montreal to Indianapolis and Edmonton to Newark during the season, while also increasing capacity on its Edmonton-San Francisco route by deploying larger Airbus aircraft. Here are more details: The expansion comes as Air Canada and United Airlines seek to deepen their presence in the Canada-US market through their joint business agreement, despite softer cross-border demand in recent months The new routes support both business and leisure travel, while advancing Air Canada's strategy of connecting US passengers through its Canadian hubs to destinations in Europe and Asia, the Canadian airline said United Airlines also announced a new seasonal service between Newark and St. John's, Newfoundland, and new flights from Denver to Ottawa and Quebec City, while increasing service on several existing Canada routes The carriers have also agreed to renew and expand their trans-border joint business agreement, subject to regulatory approval from Canadian authorities, the airline said

item.title: Mexico limits tariffs break to established local carmakers
item.description: Mexico said on Friday that a new five-year tariff break for imported car parts will apply only to automakers that already have production facilities in the country.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mexico said on Friday that a new five-year tariff break for imported car parts will apply only to automakers that already have production facilities in the country. The clarification comes several days after industry analysts raised questions about the decree's potential to open the door to Chinese brands or other newcomer car companies. A decree published Tuesday cut an import tariff to zero from 10% for certain assembly parts, including semi-knocked-down (SKD) and completely knocked-down (CKD) kits The move prompted industry analysts quoted in local media to suggest Chinese automakers such as GAC (600418.SS) and JAC (601238.SS) could be poised to benefit The economy ministry on Friday clarified that the measure applies only to companies with "productive installations" in Mexico and that meet other specific criteria The ministry said 11 carmakers were eligible under the scheme, without naming them Industry data reviewed by Reuters points to those firms as potentially being Audi, BMW (BMWG.DE) , Ford (F.N) , General Motors (GM.N) , Honda (7267.T) , Kia (000270.KS) , Mazda (7261.T) , Nissan (7201.T) , Stellantis (STLAM.MI) , Toyota (7203.T) and Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) Mexican sales of Chinese-brand vehicles [USN:L8N43J20E TEXT:"jumped nearly 30%"] in the first six months of the year despite steep tariffs intended to slow the rise of Asian imports

item.title: Amazônia tem menor desmatamento já registrado em quase 40 anos
item.description: O desmatamento na Amazônia Legal caiu 42% entre agosto de 2025 e julho de 2026, de acordo com dados do sistema de satélite Prodes divulgados nesta sexta-feira, alcançando 3.335 km², menor nível registrado desde 1988, quando o governo brasileiro iniciou a coleta de dados.
item.dc:creator: Lisandra Paraguassu
item.content:encoded: O desmatamento na Amazônia Legal caiu 42% entre agosto de 2025 e julho de 2026, de acordo com dados do sistema de satélite Prodes divulgados nesta sexta-feira, alcançando 3.335 km², menor nível registrado desde 1988, quando o governo brasileiro iniciou a coleta de dados. Nos últimos quatro anos, a queda foi de 71,2%. Os dados do Prodes também registraram uma queda recorde no desmatamento no Cerrado, que foi de 5.516 km², uma queda de 24% no último período, e o menor desde 2001, quando inicia a série histórica. Em quatro anos, a queda foi de 48,4%. Com os novos números, o Brasil recupera uma sequência de quedas no desmatamento que havia se interrompido em 2014, no caso da Amazônia, e 2019, no Cerrado. Em 2012, durante o mandato de Dilma Rousseff, o Brasil havia chegado ao recorde anterior, de 4.571 km² desmatados, depois de alcançado perto de 30 mil km² de vegetação suprimida nos anos 90. Já no Cerrado, o início dos anos 2000 foi quando se registrou os maiores desmatamentos, mas havia voltado a subir no governo de Jair Bolsonaro. A queda recomeçou em 2024. Mais cedo, durante a promulgação da Emenda Constitucional que acaba com a escala 6x1 no país, o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva cumprimentou o ministro do Meio Ambiente, João Paulo Capobianco, pelos números registrados, que seriam os menores "em todos os biomas". Os dados de Pampa, Mata Atlântica, Cerrado e Pantanal ainda não foram divulgados.

item.title: Secretária de imprensa da Casa Branca Zacharia é demitida menos de uma semana depois de ser alvo de críticas
item.description: A secretária de imprensa da Casa Branca, Katie Zacharia, foi demitida após menos de uma semana no cargo, afirmaram duas autoridades nesta sexta-feira, após um início conturbado como principal porta-voz do presidente Donald Trump.
item.dc:creator: Nandita Bose, Trevor Hunnicutt, Jasper Ward
item.content:encoded: A secretária de imprensa da Casa Branca, Katie Zacharia, foi demitida após menos de uma semana no cargo, afirmaram duas autoridades nesta sexta-feira, após um início conturbado como principal porta-voz do presidente Donald Trump. Zacharia foi “dispensada” e estava “deixando” o cargo de secretária de imprensa, segundo duas autoridades distintas da Casa Branca. Ela enfrentou dias de questionamentos sobre suas credenciais legais e críticas ao seu desempenho em uma coletiva de imprensa e em entrevistas. A saída deixa Trump sem uma importante porta-voz a pouco mais de duas semanas das eleições de meio de mandato de novembro, um período crítico em que o presidente busca divulgar as conquistas de seu governo e ajudar seus pares republicanos a manter o controle do Congresso. Trump disse aos repórteres na manhã desta sexta-feira que havia pedido a Zacharia que reconsiderasse se continuaria no cargo após enfrentar uma cobertura jornalística severa durante seus primeiros dias no cargo. “Eu disse a ela: ‘Acho que é melhor você ser feliz, e não tenho certeza se você conseguirá ser feliz nessa função’. Não há nada de fácil nisso”, disse Trump aos repórteres ao deixar a Casa Branca para uma viagem. Ele acrescentou: “Eu disse a ela com toda a sinceridade: ‘Se eu fosse você, reconsideraria... pensaria nisso. Mas eu reconsideraria’”. Trump disse que pretendia retomar a conversa com Zacharia mais tarde. Zacharia assumiu o cargo na segunda-feira e realizou sua primeira coletiva de imprensa na Casa Branca na terça-feira. Ela disse que recebeu uma ligação sobre o cargo de secretária de imprensa na última quarta-feira e que recebeu a oferta para suceder Karoline Leavitt na última sexta-feira. Logo ela enfrentou perguntas sobre sua carreira, que, segundo ela, incluiu uma passagem atuando como advogada. Trump também a havia descrito como advogada. “Atuei na área de direito de transações internacionais, com todas as credenciais necessárias”, disse Zacharia em um comunicado enviado por email na quarta-feira. A Reuters não conseguiu encontrar registros que comprovassem que a graduada pela faculdade de direito da Universidade Pepperdine estivesse registrada como advogada ou membro da Ordem dos Advogados em qualquer Estado dos EUA ou no Distrito de Columbia. Durante uma entrevista à Fox News na quinta-feira, Zacharia disse que não foi aprovada no exame da ordem. Graduados em direito não podem exercer legalmente a advocacia nos EUA sem primeiro serem admitidos na ordem dos advogados de um Estado. Zacharia e a Casa Branca não responderam imediatamente a um email solicitando comentários sobre sua demissão. Mais cedo nesta sexta-feira, ela disse a repórteres na Casa Branca que estava ansiosa para trabalhar com a imprensa. Trump contratou Zacharia após expressar preocupações com a cobertura da mídia sobre seu governo, sentindo que precisava de uma nova porta-voz que pudesse destacar suas conquistas, segundo duas pessoas a par das conversas. Em entrevista por telefone à Fox nesta sexta-feira, Trump disse que não tinha pressa em nomear uma nova secretária de imprensa. A rápida saída de Zacharia significou que ela teve o que se acredita ser o mandato mais curto de qualquer secretária de imprensa na história do cargo. “Recordes são feitos para serem quebrados”, disse Anthony Scaramucci, que atuou como diretor de comunicações por 10 dias durante o primeiro governo de Trump, no X. “Mas não sinto prazer com o sofrimento alheio.”

item.title: Falhas da Starlink afetam linhas de frente da guerra na Ucrânia
item.description: Para uma unidade de artilharia que luta no leste da Ucrânia, a decisão dos Estados Unidos desta semana de reduzir os serviços fornecidos pela empresa de satélite Starlink aos militares teve um impacto imediato.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Para uma unidade de artilharia que luta no leste da Ucrânia, a decisão dos Estados Unidos desta semana de reduzir os serviços fornecidos pela empresa de satélite Starlink aos militares teve um impacto imediato. As comunicações com o quartel-general foram interrompidas e a velocidade da internet caiu, representando riscos em uma guerra onde drones são um perigo constante e informações atualizadas sobre alvos e ameaças podem fazer a diferença entre a vida e a morte. "Logo após o anúncio de que a conexão com o Starlink estava se deteriorando, isso realmente teve um impacto negativo", disse Ukrlan, de 28 anos, que serve em uma unidade de artilharia do Batalhão Especial de Polícia de Rifles. Ele pediu para ser identificado apenas pelo seu indicativo de chamada, em conformidade com a prática militar ucraniana. "Sentimos isso imediatamente", disse ele à Reuters de seu bunker perto da linha de frente na região de Donbas, palco de intensos combates. "A velocidade da internet em nossa posição havia se deteriorado significativamente, assim como a comunicação com nosso quartel-general e nosso comando." Segundo autoridades, a Casa Branca emitiu uma ordem para limitar o uso do sistema de satélites Starshield da SpaceX, utilizado pela Ucrânia para comunicações em campo de batalha e operações com drones. Um funcionário norte-americano negou que o presidente Donald Trump tenha ordenado uma desaceleração deliberada do Starshield, e Trump afirmou esta semana que o compartilhamento de informações de inteligência com a Ucrânia continua. A Ucrânia e seus parceiros ocidentais criticaram a desaceleração, considerando-a uma ajuda à Rússia na guerra, que começou há quase cinco anos com a invasão em grande escala por Moscou. Os EUA afirmam que desejam pôr fim à guerra e estão trabalhando para isso. Embora grande parte da atenção tenha se concentrado no Starshield, a versão de nível militar do serviço Starlink da SpaceX, os comentários de Ukrlan apontam para interrupções mais amplas que afetam a conectividade e a velocidade da internet. O RUGIDO DA ARMA O presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, disse a líderes em Bruxelas na sexta-feira que os serviços Starlink haviam melhorado, mas ainda não haviam sido totalmente restaurados, o que, segundo ele, colocava vidas civis em risco. "O Starlink é realmente necessário para a Ucrânia. E, infelizmente, a curto prazo, a Europa não pode substituir essa capacidade", disse a chefe da diplomacia da UE, Kaja Kallas. A unidade de Ukrlan disparava um obus contra alvos russos a partir de uma posição fortemente camuflada, escavada profundamente no solo. Os soldados preparavam apressadamente os projéteis em um bunker escuro, com estrutura de madeira, à luz de lanternas de cabeça, tapando os ouvidos cada vez que o canhão rugia e enchia o espaço de fumaça. Soldados ucranianos afirmaram que a menor velocidade da conexão Starlink prejudicou a capacidade das forças armadas de detectar e interceptar mísseis e drones. A medida dos EUA de restringir temporariamente o sistema ocorreu em meio à pressão do presidente Donald Trump sobre Kiev para que esta interrompa seus ataques às refinarias de petróleo russas. Ele atribuiu esses ataques ao aumento vertiginoso dos preços da energia, que está prejudicando as perspectivas de seu Partido Republicano nas eleições de meio de mandato de novembro, embora especialistas afirmem que o aumento seja principalmente resultado da guerra dos EUA com o Irã. Para os ucranianos, as consequências dessa abordagem são claras. "A princípio, ele insistiu veementemente que nos ajudaria a pôr fim a isso em um curto espaço de tempo", disse Ukrlan, referindo-se à promessa de Trump de encerrar a guerra na Ucrânia logo após seu retorno ao cargo. "Mas não vimos nenhum sinal disso. E as coisas só pioram a cada dia, a cada semana." (Por Sergiy Chalyi)

item.title: Cardinals rule out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) vs. Rams
item.description: Arizona Cardinals running back Jeremiyah Love will miss Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Rams with an ankle injury.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Arizona Cardinals running back Jeremiyah Love will miss Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Rams with an ankle injury. Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur confirmed the rookie's status on Friday after he missed practice for the third straight day. Love, 21, has rushed for 245 yards and one touchdown in five games (four starts), adding 11 catches for 36 yards and a TD. Arizona drafted Love with the No. 3 overall pick in the 2026 NFL Draft out of Notre Dame. LaFleur said there have not been any conversations about putting Love on injured reserve, indicating his absence won't be too extensive. Tyler Allgeier and Bam Knight will handle the backfield duties Sunday when the Cardinals (1-4) visit the NFC West rival Rams (2-3). --Field Level Media

item.title: Por que CoreWeave está na mira do pânico em torno da IA
item.description: A CoreWeave , empresa norte-americana de computação em nuvem que opera no vermelho e está profundamente endividada, tornou-se um alvo fácil nesta semana para investidores preocupados com uma bolha na indústria da inteligência artificial.
item.dc:creator: Vidya Ranganathan, Aditya Soni
item.content:encoded: A CoreWeave (CRWV.O) , empresa norte-americana de computação em nuvem que opera no vermelho e está profundamente endividada, tornou-se um alvo fácil nesta semana para investidores preocupados com uma bolha na indústria da inteligência artificial. A queda nas ações e o aumento do rendimento dos títulos de dívida da empresa avaliada em US$39 bilhões e que é apoiada pela Nvidia (NVDA.O) , ocorreu depois que resultados do terceiro trimestre de grandes empresas de tecnologia sugeriram atrasos em projetos de data centers e um ritmo mais lento de crescimento nos investimentos em IA. Investidores voltaram suas atenções para as empresas de computação em nuvem baseadas em IA, ou “neoclouds”, como a CoreWeave, possivelmente os elos mais fracos do ecossistema de IA devido ao fato de que essas empresas recorrem fortemente a empréstimos para financiar compra de chips, terrenos e energia para suas instalações que só gerarão receita no futuro. As ações da CoreWeave despencaram mais de 15% nesta semana, enquanto os rendimentos de seus títulos com vencimento em 2030 saltaram 500 pontos-base, chegando a cerca de 16%. O presidente-executivo da CoreWeave, Mike Intrator, disse aos funcionários em memorando visto pela Reuters que os mercados às vezes podem “interpretar mal e agir de forma irracional” e que a empresa possui uma sólida carteira de pedidos. A empresa não respondeu a pedidos de comentário da Reuters. Os investidores concentraram-se, em vez disso, na dívida de US$50 bilhões da CoreWeave e nos riscos da companhia ficar presa no meio de um esquema de financiamento circular entre fabricantes de chips, como a Nvidia, e clientes como Meta (META.O) e OpenAI. “O problema com tudo isso é que estamos falando de uma enorme interconectividade, não apenas do financiamento circular, mas do fato de que esses ativos são todos mantidos nos mesmos lugares, nas mesmas carteiras, pelos mesmos tipos de investidores”, disse James Athey, gestor de carteiras de renda fixa da Marlborough. “E a alavancagem é sempre aquele fator que transforma uma tempestade em um copo d’água em algo mais nefasto”, disse ele, referindo-se de maneira geral ao nervosismo em torno da IA. Empresas como CoreWeave, Nebius (NBIS.O) , Applied Digital (APLD.O) , Iren (IREN.O) , Lambda Labs, Crusoe e TeraWulf (WULF.O) estão construindo data centers que consomem muita energia e que, eventualmente, poderão ser alugados para empresas que desenvolvem e operam modelos de IA. Isso exige um investimento inicial maciço e gera muito pouca receita até que os contratos de locação comecem. A CoreWeave nunca registrou lucro, de acordo com dados compilados pela LSEG. O presidente da CoreWeave também afirmou no memorando que a carteira de negócios em andamento cobre amplamente as obrigações de dívida da companhia. A empresa tinha uma carteira de receitas de US$104,2 bilhões no final do segundo trimestre, seguida por mais de US$25 bilhões em novos compromissos no início do terceiro trimestre. Mas a companhia sediada em Nova Jersey está queimando caixa mais rápido do que os investidores gostariam. Em 2025, a CoreWeave teve receita anual de US$5,1 bilhões e prejuízo líquido de US$1,2 bilhão. Embora se espere que a receita da CoreWeave dobre este ano, o mercado calcula que os investimentos da empresa vão quadruplicar, ficando entre US$35 bilhões e US$39 bilhões, levando a um consumo de caixa ainda maior neste ano. A notícia de que Intrator e entidades ligadas a ela venderam quase US$1 bilhão em ações desde a abertura de capital da empresa em março do ano passado, principalmente por meio de planos de negociação pré-acordados, conforme documentos regulatórios, não ajudou em nada a companhia. “É claro que eles precisarão de uma injeção de capital ou de um resgate financeiro. Estão queimando capital, e o capital não é mais de graça”, disse Alberto Gallo, fundador do fundo de hedge Andromeda Capital. “Você quer comprar dívida de empresas que tenham fluxo de caixa visível, normalmente como investidor em títulos de dívida, e não de alguém que está realizando investimentos em ativos fixos, na esperança de que haja necessidade de mais investimentos no futuro”, disse Gallo, cuja empresa mantém posições vendidas contra os títulos da CoreWeave. MUITAS DÚVIDAS A CoreWeave está no topo da lista de cerca de 100 “neoclouds” que, segundo a empresa de pesquisa de mercado Gartner, são “as mais expostas ao desequilíbrio entre receita e investimentos” e precisam gerar retornos em breve para sustentar suas operações. A Gartner prevê que até 2030, 80% dos provedores de “neocloud” encerrarão operações independentes. “Estamos em uma situação em que há muitas expectativas em relação às receitas e ao crescimento das receitas, mas esse crescimento está sendo alimentado pelo tipo errado de capital, que é a dívida, e não o patrimônio líquido”, disse Tommaso Leodari, diretor de investimentos do fundo de hedge Index & Cie, com sede em Dubai. O fundo não detém participações em empresas exclusivamente de IA. “No caso específico da CoreWeave, esses caras estão financiando todo o seu negócio com dívida. Portanto, se algo acontecer na utilização desse ativo específico ou se houver uma desaceleração na construção desses data centers, isso se refletirá em problemas no pagamento da dívida.” Uma série de alertas de gigantes da IA, como Microsoft (MSFT.O) e Oracle Corp (ORCL.N) , sobre atrasos em projetos de data centers, gargalos no fornecimento de energia e componentes, um excesso de oferta de chips sofisticados, juntamente com os planos de gigantes como Meta e Microsoft de lançar seus próprios microprocessadores para rivalizar com os da Nvidia, também alimentaram preocupações sobre as “neoclouds”. O ritmo de crescimento da receita de gigantes da IA, como OpenAI e Anthropic, embora ainda rápido, também diminuiu. “Mesmo com uma receita de US$10 bilhões, a CoreWeave está tendo um prejuízo de US$2,5 bilhões, portanto, ainda não há efeitos de escala evidentes no setor”, escreveu Michael Frazis, da Frazis Capital Partners, com sede em Sydney. A CoreWeave conta com o apoio da Nvidia. A gigante dos chips fez acordo para comprar a capacidade computacional não vendida da CoreWeave até abril de 2032, garantindo que a empresa terá um comprador para a capacidade não vendida aos clientes. As agências de recomendação de risco classificam a dívida da CoreWeave como de grau especulativo; no entanto, Sean Cray, vice-presidente da Moody’s Ratings, destacou que a empresa não compra chips de forma especulativa e possui múltiplas fontes de financiamento. Originalmente uma mineradora de bitcoin, a CoreWeave ainda tem sido um alvo fácil para especuladores, e os fundos de hedge vêm comprando seus títulos com recomendação de risco para obter alto rendimento. O custo do seguro contra inadimplência de sua dívida subiu para cerca de 1.200 pontos-base nesta semana, sinalizando graves dificuldades. “A liquidação do crédito da CoreWeave corre o risco de se tornar uma profecia autorrealizável”, escreveu Saurav Sen, da empresa de pesquisa Gimme Credit. “A preocupação não é tanto se os clientes querem a capacidade, mas se a CoreWeave tem condições financeiras para fornecê-la.”

item.title: Trump afirma que nem ele nem Musk são responsáveis pela perda de acesso à Starlink na Ucrânia
item.description: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, disse na sexta-feira que não acredita que ele ou Elon Musk tenham sido responsáveis pela perda, por parte da Ucrânia, do acesso à Starlink — uma situação que afetou as operações militares do país contra a Rússia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, disse na sexta-feira que não acredita que ele ou Elon Musk tenham sido responsáveis pela perda, por parte da Ucrânia, do acesso à Starlink — uma situação que afetou as operações militares do país contra a Rússia. A redução nos serviços prestados pela empresa de satélites interrompeu as comunicações com o quartel-general e causou uma queda na velocidade da internet. A Reuters informou na quinta-feira que a Casa Branca aprovou a redução nos serviços do Starshield. Trump, ao falar com repórteres ao sair da Casa Branca para uma viagem à Geórgia, disse que nem ele nem Musk eram responsáveis pela perda de acesso da Ucrânia à Starlink. Qualquer limitação ao acesso da Ucrânia ao sistema Starshield não foi imposta pelos Estados Unidos, acrescentou Trump. O Starshield foi desenvolvido pela SpaceX especificamente para clientes de governo e da segurança nacional, particularmente o Departamento de Defesa dos EUA. O Starshield utiliza a constelação Starlink como sua espinha dorsal. Trump também afirmou ter um bom relacionamento com o presidente da Ucrânia, Volodymyr Zelenskiy.

item.title: Gold set for a weekly drop as traders assess Fed signals
item.description: Gold prices were largely steady on Friday and were on track for a weekly loss as traders weighed the prospect of further Federal Reserve rate hikes this year following a run of hotter-than-expected US inflation data.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Sinha
item.content:encoded: Gold prices were largely steady on Friday and were on track for a weekly loss as traders weighed the prospect of further Federal Reserve rate hikes this year following a run of hotter-than-expected US inflation data. Spot gold was down 0.1% at $4,165.12 per ounce by 02:07 p.m. EDT (1807 GMT) but was down 0.7% so far in the week. US gold futures for December delivery settled 0.3% higher at $4,181.10 per ounce. "We're very much rangebound and tilting toward the lower bound of support, the main reason being we still have a lot of ambiguity in what the Fed will do," Bart Melek, global head of commodity strategy at TD Securities, said. Federal Reserve Chair [USN:L6N462084 TEXT:"Kevin Warsh"] voiced optimism about US economic strength but gave no clues about the central bank's rate-path trajectory. Data on Thursday showed US [USN:L1N4610KT TEXT:"producer prices"] increased by the most in 4-1/2 years last month. The data followed Wednesday's [USN:L1N45Z121 TEXT:"consumer price"] report, which showed prices accelerated in September. Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago President Austan Goolsbee said the data was "[USN:SPN45O00I TEXT:"discouraging"]" while Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack said the Fed might need to hike interest rates more aggressively if there were to be a [USN:L6N4611E0 TEXT:"notable deterioration"] in the public's inflation expectations. Traders largely expect the US central bank to hold rates steady this month, while pricing in a 90% chance of a rate hike in December, according to the CME's FedWatch Tool. Although gold is typically seen as an inflation hedge, higher interest rates tend to reduce the appeal of the non-yielding metal. "Over the rest of this year, gold prices are likely to edge lower as the Fed continues raising rates and fears around the end of the AI boom prove to be temporary," Hamad Hussain, a climate and commodities economist at Capital Economics, said. Elsewhere, gold traded at a premium in India this week for the first time in more than three months as a pullback in prices boosted jewellery purchases. Among other metals, spot silver fell 0.7% to $57.05 per ounce, platinum was unchanged at $1,626.15 and palladium was down 1.1% to $1,113.61. All three metals headed for weekly losses.

item.title: FAA set to approve Boeing 737 MAX 10 as soon as next week, sources say
item.description: The Federal Aviation Administration is set to approve the long-delayed Boeing 737 MAX 10 as soon as next week, after completing a key safety review on Friday, three people familiar with the matter said.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson, Dan Catchpole
item.content:encoded: The Federal Aviation Administration is set to approve the long-delayed Boeing (BA.N) 737 MAX 10 as soon as next week, after completing a key safety review on Friday, three people familiar with the matter said. The review by the Type Certification Board — made up of FAA management team members — is a final step before the agency decides on certification. The MAX 10 is a larger variant of Boeing's best-selling 737 MAX and its expected approval marks a key milestone for the US planemaker. Boeing has faced a more stringent certification process since two fatal MAX 8 crashes in 2018 and 2019, as well as scrutiny of the company's production and quality systems after a January 2024 mid-air cabin panel blowout on a nearly new Alaska Airlines (ALK.N) MAX 9. Asked for comment, the FAA said, "Safety dictates the certification timeline." Boeing referred questions to the FAA. The FAA in August gave long-awaited approval to the smaller 737 MAX 7 after reviewing the plane for more than eight years. Boeing at one point planned to start delivering the MAX 10 in 2020. A problem with the anti-ice system on 737 MAX engines that arose in 2023 further delayed certification of the MAX 7 and 10. The delays have helped European rival Airbus' (AIR.PA) A321neo secure a greater share of the large single-aisle market. Boeing has said the MAX 10 will be a major cash-flow driver in its ongoing financial recovery following years of crises and controversies. Airlines have ordered nearly 1,500 MAX 10s, and the model accounts for about 30% of Boeing's outstanding 737 backlog. The planemaker has already built a handful of MAX 10s awaiting delivery. The bigger plane that can carry more passengers is crucial to several airlines' growth plans. Major customers for the MAX 10 include United Airlines (UAL.O) , Alaska, Ryanair (RYA.I) , Delta Air Lines (DAL.N) and American Airlines (AAL.O) . A glitch with the latest update of the 737 MAX's navigation software threatened to further delay certification when Boeing disclosed it in late September. However, the FAA determined on October 2 that it did not pose a safety concern and did not require Boeing to fix the problem as a condition of certifying the plane. Boeing is still working on certifying the 777-9, its largest jetliner in production, which is already six years behind schedule. The company has said it expects to complete certification and begin deliveries in 2027.

item.title: Djokovic vuelve a Basilea por primera vez desde 2011 en busca de clasificar al ATP Finals
item.description: Novak Djokovic recibió el viernes una invitación para jugar el torneo de Basilea, lo que supone su primera participación desde 2011, mientras el ganador de 24 torneos del Grand Slam busca una plaza en el ATP Finals, el torneo que pone fin a la temporada, y el 103º título de su carrera.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Novak Djokovic recibió el viernes una invitación para jugar el torneo de Basilea, lo que supone su primera participación desde 2011, mientras el ganador de 24 torneos del Grand Slam busca una plaza en el ATP Finals, el torneo que pone fin a la temporada, y el 103º título de su carrera. El serbio, de 39 años, llega a Suiza tras una gira asiática con resultados dispares, en la que se alzó con su séptimo título en el Abierto de China antes de sufrir una sorprendente derrota en segunda ronda ante el polaco Hubert Hurkacz en el Masters de Shanghái. Djokovic ha atravesado una temporada irregular para lo que suelen ser sus estándares. El exnúmero uno del mundo quedó fuera del Abierto de Estados Unidos en primera ronda, su eliminación más temprana en un Grand Slam desde el Abierto de Australia de 2006. La decisión de añadir Basilea a su calendario resulta sorprendente, ya que Djokovic había declarado tras su eliminación en Shanghái que tenía previsto disputar únicamente el Masters de París, del 2 al 8 de noviembre, antes del ATP Finals. Basilea ofrece a Djokovic la oportunidad de reforzar sus opciones de sumar su 17ª participación en el ATP Finals. Ocupa el puesto 11 de la ATP y necesita terminar entre los nueve primeros, ya que el número uno del mundo, Jannik Sinner, estará de baja durante el resto de 2026 debido a una lesión de rodilla. Djokovic participará por cuarta vez en Basilea, donde ya se alzó con el trofeo en 2009 tras derrotar en la final al suizo Roger Federer. Se une así a un potente cuadro que incluye al canadiense Félix Auger-Aliassime y a los estadounidenses Ben Shelton y Taylor Fritz en el torneo ATP 500 sobre pista dura cubierta, que se disputará del 26 de octubre al 1 de noviembre.

item.title: Trump affirme que ni lui ni Musk n'ont bridé Starlink en Ukraine

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le président américain Donald Trump a déclaré vendredi qu'il ne pensait pas que lui-même ou Elon Musk soient responsables du fait que l'armée ukrainienne n'ait plus accès aux capacités militaires de Starlink. Le président américain a ajouté qu'il entretenait de bonnes relations avec son homologue ukrainien Volodimir Zelensky, quelques jours après avoir souhaité son départ du pouvoir pour permettre, selon lui, la conclusion d'un accord de paix avec la Russie.

item.title: Putin dice que Rusia está creando "zona de seguridad" innegociable en Ucrania a lo largo de frontera
item.description: Rusia está estableciendo una "zona de seguridad" en el interior de Ucrania, a lo largo de su frontera, que no será objeto de negociación en ninguna futura ronda de conversaciones con Kiev, afirmó el viernes el presidente Vladimir Putin.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Rusia está estableciendo una "zona de seguridad" en el interior de Ucrania, a lo largo de su frontera, que no será objeto de negociación en ninguna futura ronda de conversaciones con Kiev, afirmó el viernes el presidente Vladimir Putin. Vestido con uniforme militar y hablando durante una visita a un puesto de mando, Putin afirmó que la operación es una respuesta a la incursión de Ucrania en la región occidental rusa de Kursk en 2024-25. "Las Fuerzas Armadas rusas recibieron el encargo no solo de expulsar al enemigo de nuestro territorio, sino también de establecer una zona de seguridad en el territorio adyacente. Esta tarea se está llevando a cabo con éxito", afirmó en declaraciones televisadas. "Nuestro objetivo es garantizar la seguridad absoluta de las regiones fronterizas de Rusia de cara al futuro, y no tenemos intención de convertir esto en un asunto para posibles negociaciones de paz con Ucrania", agregó. El portavoz del Kremlin, Dmitri Peskov, señaló que la zona de seguridad prevista abarca 660 kilómetros, de los cuales el 70% se encuentran actualmente bajo control ruso. No precisó hasta qué profundidad se adentraría en el territorio de Ucrania. Putin ya se había referido antes a la necesidad de una zona de este tipo, pero hasta ahora no había detallado su extensión prevista ni había afirmado que quedara excluida de las negociaciones. Esto implica que Rusia debe hacerse con territorio en las regiones de Sumy y Járkov, que no figuran entre las que ha reivindicado como propio desde que inició la guerra en Ucrania en 2022. Putin dijo que sus fuerzas deben capturar aún algo más del 10% del territorio de la región ucraniana de Donetsk —un objetivo clave— y el 16,5% de Zaporiyia. Elogió la eficacia de los ataques contra objetivos militares, industriales y logísticos ucranianos, al tiempo que añadió que aún hay margen de mejora en las defensas aéreas rusas.

item.title: Deforestation in Brazil's Amazon falls to all-time low
item.description: Deforestation in Brazil's Amazon rainforest declined to the lowest level on record in the 12 months through July, according to data released by Brazilian space research agency Inpe on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Lisandra Paraguassu, Andre Romani
item.content:encoded: Deforestation in Brazil's Amazon rainforest declined to the lowest level on record in the 12 months through July, according to data released by Brazilian space research agency Inpe on Friday. Some 3,335 square kilometers (1,287.65 square miles) of Amazon jungle were destroyed in the 12 months through July, an all-time low in the historical series that goes back to 1988. It was a fall of about 42% from the preceding period. The previous lowest level for Brazil's Amazon deforestation was reached in 2011-2012, when 4,571 square kilometers were destroyed. In the mid-90s, the figure had reached a record high of nearly 30,000 square kilometers destroyed a year. The data released on Friday, which is produced yearly by Inpe's PRODES satellite monitoring program, is measured from August to July as there is less cloud cover in the middle of the year to obscure deforestation on satellite images. "The figures released today are a historic achievement," said Marcio Astrini, executive secretary at climate advocacy group Observatorio do Clima, adding they show the world that "with political will, it is possible to curb deforestation and greenhouse gas emissions." President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva took office in 2023 [USN:S0N37201F TEXT:"pledging to end deforestation"] by 2030, after it soared to its highest in 15 years during the administration of former President Jair Bolsonaro. Lula will face Bolsonaro's eldest son, Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, in a [USN:S0N45N09L TEXT:"presidential election runoff"] on October 25, after the younger Bolsonaro performed better than expected in the first round. The senator pledged in his manifesto to strengthen environmental oversight in the Amazon, prioritizing areas under the greatest pressure from deforestation and wildfires. He said law enforcement would focus on organized crime rather than on extractive workers and small farmers. In Brazil's Cerrado savanna, deforestation fell about 24% in the period, to some 5,517 square kilometers, also the lowest on record in a series going back to 2001, Inpe data showed.

item.title: Producción de cobre en Perú cae 5,0% interanual en agosto, a 230.676 toneladas: gobierno
item.description: La producción de cobre de Perú, la tercera mayor a nivel mundial, cayó un 5,0% interanual en agosto, a unas 230.676 toneladas métricas, según un reporte del Ministerio de Energía y Minas difundido el viernes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La producción de cobre de Perú, la tercera mayor a nivel mundial, cayó un 5,0% interanual en agosto, a unas 230.676 toneladas métricas, según un reporte del Ministerio de Energía y Minas difundido el viernes. Entre enero y agosto la producción de cobre local aumentó un 1,2% interanual, a 1.829.790 toneladas métricas, detalló el ministerio en un informe preliminar sin más detalles. Perú produjo el año pasado unas 2,77 millones de toneladas de cobre, un nivel estable en los últimos tres años por la falta de nuevos proyectos, conflictos sociales y la disminución de las leyes del mineral en las grandes minas, según la industria.

item.title: US annual budget gap hits nearly $2 trillion, largest in 5 years
item.description: The US budget deficit rose by $217 billion to nearly $2 trillion in the 2026 fiscal year, fueled in part by tariff refunds and record spending to service the nation's more than $40 trillion in debt, marking the largest budget shortfall in five years, Treasury Department figures showed on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Dan Burns
item.content:encoded: The US budget deficit rose by $217 billion to nearly $2 trillion in the 2026 fiscal year, fueled in part by tariff refunds and record spending to service the nation's more than $40 trillion in debt, marking the largest budget shortfall in five years, Treasury Department figures showed on Friday. Continued increases in spending for social benefits programs like Social Security and Medicare and a $48 billion jump in defense spending also factored into the increase. The $1.99 trillion deficit for the year ended September 30, the first full budget year of President Donald Trump's second term, was up from $1.78 trillion in fiscal 2025. It was the largest shortfall since fiscal 2021's $2.77 trillion budget gap, then fueled by COVID-19 pandemic relief spending, and is the third-largest annual deficit ever. Total receipts for fiscal 2026 were a record $5.40 trillion, up $169 billion, or 3%, from the $5.24 trillion in fiscal 2025. Fiscal 2026 outlays also were a record at $7.40 trillion, up $386 billion, or 6%, from the $7.01 trillion in the prior fiscal year. Debt-service outlays totaled a record $1.36 trillion, climbing by $144 billion, or 12%, a spending category now eclipsed only by Social Security and the combined outlays for Medicare and Medicaid. Total US debt breached the $40 trillion milestone about two months ago. Another driver of the widening shortfall was a $22 billion drop in net tariff receipts following a Supreme Court ruling this year negating a large portion of the tariffs Trump had imposed during his first year in office. That triggered $145 billion of tariff refunds over this year, resulting in an 11% decline in net tariff income to about $173 billion. Defense spending for the year rose by 6% to $917 billion. A US Treasury official said it was not clear how much of the increase could be attributed to the war Trump and Israel started against Iran earlier this year. The Treasury official said the department calculated an estimated deficit-to-GDP ratio of 6.2% for fiscal 2026, but declined to say what GDP estimate was used. This figure compares to an actual 5.8% deficit-to-GDP ratio for fiscal 2025. For the 2026 fiscal year's final month of September, the Treasury reported a deficit of $27 billion versus a $198 billion surplus a year earlier.

item.title: Falcons QB Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) to start vs. Bears
item.description: Atlanta Falcons quarterback Michael Penix Jr. did not receive an injury designation on Friday and is on track to start Sunday's game against the visiting Chicago Bears.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Atlanta Falcons quarterback Michael Penix Jr. did not receive an injury designation on Friday and is on track to start Sunday's game against the visiting Chicago Bears. Penix, who has been a full participant in practice this week, sustained a rib injury late in the fourth quarter of last Sunday's 30-23 overtime loss to the Baltimore Ravens. Tua Tagovailoa replaced Penix in overtime and threw a game-ending interception on his second play. Penix, 26, missed the first two weeks of this season to complete his recovery from ACL surgery. He has completed 67.5% of his passes for 719 yards, three touchdowns and one interception while posting a 2-1 record in three starts. Atlanta defensive end Za'Darius Smith (neck) has cleared the concussion protocol but is listed as questionable to play on Sunday. Cornerback C.J. Henderson (groin) has been ruled out for the Falcons (2-3). --Field Level Media

item.title: Ravens rule out QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) vs. Browns
item.description: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson will miss his second straight game with an ankle injury on Sunday at Cleveland.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson will miss his second straight game with an ankle injury on Sunday at Cleveland. Tyler Huntley will start under center when the Ravens (4-1) visit the AFC North rival Browns (3-2), the team confirmed Friday. Jackson has not practiced since sustaining the injury late in the first half in the Week 4 win against the Tennessee Titans. Earlier this week, Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said the two-time NFL MVP remains "definitely day-to-day." "To Lamar's credit, he's working his butt off," Minter said Wednesday. "He's doing everything he can to be out here. And when he's able to be, he will." Jackson, 29, has completed 70.8% of his passes for 967 yards, six touchdowns and one interception in four games this season. He has rushed for 144 yards and one score. Huntley, 28, completed 24 of 32 passes for 201 yards, two touchdowns and no interceptions in last Sunday's 30-23 overtime win at Atlanta. His 1-yard touchdown run in overtime gave Baltimore its third straight win. --Field Level Media

item.title: Putin concorda em cooperar com apelo do papa Leão por ajuda a cidade ucraniana
item.description: O presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, disse ao papa Leão que havia concordado em cooperar depois que o pontífice lhe pediu, nesta sexta-feira, que ajude a levar suprimentos essenciais para a cidade ucraniana de Oleshky, controlada pela Rússia, informou o Kremlin.
item.dc:creator: Joshua McElwee
item.content:encoded: O presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, disse ao papa Leão que havia concordado em cooperar depois que o pontífice lhe pediu, nesta sexta-feira, que ajude a levar suprimentos essenciais para a cidade ucraniana de Oleshky, controlada pela Rússia, informou o Kremlin. Leão ligou para Putin e pediu que ele providenciasse um cessar-fogo para permitir a entrada de ajuda humanitária e alimentos na cidade, tomada pelas forças russas em fevereiro de 2022, informou o Vaticano. Moradores relataram um agravamento da crise alimentar. Leão expressou “profunda preocupação” com a situação humanitária no local, acrescentou o Vaticano. Rússia e Ucrânia acusam-se mutuamente de bloquear o envio de suprimentos para a cidade, que as forças ucranianas pretendem retomar. “A intenção do Vaticano de ajudar a criar as condições necessárias para garantir a segurança da população da cidade e organizar o fornecimento de suprimentos essenciais recebeu apoio”, afirmou o Kremlin em comunicado. O comunicado não mencionou um cessar-fogo. “Ficou acordado que haverá cooperação nessa questão”, acrescentou. Sabe-se que Leão e Putin já haviam conversado uma vez anteriormente, em junho de 2025. O papa também reafirmou o compromisso da Santa Sé com quaisquer iniciativas em prol da paz, informou o Vaticano. O papa, de 71 anos, está se recuperando no hospital Gemelli, em Roma, após uma cirurgia para retirada de um câncer de pulmão. O Vaticano informou na manhã desta sexta-feira que ele apresenta melhora constante e está apto a trabalhar e realizar atividades diárias normais. O Kremlin informou que Putin desejou a Leão uma recuperação rápida e completa. O secretário de Estado do Vaticano, cardeal Pietro Parolin, disse aos repórteres após a ligação que a iniciativa partiu de Leão. O papa, segundo ele, queria “defender a causa dessa cidade sitiada”. A Rússia reconheceu problemas graves com alimentos e suprimentos médicos em Oleshky e afirmou que suas Forças Armadas estavam trabalhando para resolvê-los. O país culpou a Ucrânia pela crise, alegando que ela estava impedindo que esses suprimentos chegassem à cidade. A Ucrânia afirmou que é a Rússia quem está impedindo as entregas de alimentos. Oleshky, na região de Kherson, na Ucrânia, tinha uma população de cerca de 24 mil habitantes antes da guerra e ainda abriga cerca de 1.700 residentes, incluindo 47 crianças, segundo Danielle Bell, chefe da Missão de Monitoramento dos Direitos Humanos da ONU na Ucrânia.

item.title: EU to propose import curbs on other Chinese sectors, says EU chief
item.description: The European Commission will propose curbs on imports from China going beyond the safeguard measures it agreed with Beijing to halve inbound shipments of Chinese hybrid cars, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Philip Blenkinsop
item.content:encoded: The European Commission will propose curbs on imports from China going beyond the safeguard measures it [USN:L6N45V0LF TEXT:"agreed with Beijing"] to halve inbound shipments of Chinese hybrid cars, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said on Friday. Von der Leyen told a news conference after an EU summit that the deal struck with China would not fix the structural imbalance. The EU's goods trade deficit with China is running at more than €1 billion ($1.12 billion) a day. "And this is why we need to act," she said. "Our industries have called for action and we have heard them and we will respond, including some more safeguards." She said this was clearly supported by EU leaders. French President Emmanuel Macron told reporters after the summit that the EU should focus on measures for chemicals, plastics and ferro-alloys. Von der Leyen said that she welcomed a [USN:L6N45R0Q0 TEXT:"Franco-German paper"] published last month, which proposed the European Union reinforce its economy by enacting a new rapid-action measure to strike back against countries that harm it. She said the Commission would develop a new instrument to rapidly limit access to the EU single market where this was in the bloc's interest. She also said the EU's executive Commission would make a proposal in December for a new instrument that would limit EU companies' reliance on single sources for certain critical supplies. The Commission would also propose a "solidarity mechanism" to help countries or sectors that are subject to coercion or retaliation from outside the EU. ($1 = 0.8913 euros)

item.title: Uncertain forecast affects ALCS Game 4 plans for Guardians, Rays
item.description: CLEVELAND -- The Guardians have wrested home-field advantage from the Tampa Bay Rays in the American League Championship Series and taken a 2-1 lead in the best-of-seven matchup.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: CLEVELAND -- The Guardians have wrested home-field advantage from the Tampa Bay Rays in the American League Championship Series and taken a 2-1 lead in the best-of-seven matchup. Beyond that, little is certain as the teams prepare to play Game 4 on Friday night. Guardians manager Stephen Vogt and Rays counterpart Kevin Cash initially did not name their starting pitchers, despite inquiries on the subject. Extended periods of rain are also in the forecast, forcing MLB officials to work on contingency plans if a postponement occurs. The next two games take place in Cleveland before Sunday's scheduled travel day. "Having as much momentum as we can possibly have and being able to feed off of that, it's a lot of fun," said Guardians center fielder Petey Halpin, who hit his first postseason home run on Thursday in Game 3. "We feed off the crowd, feed off the energy. It's great." Halpin's two-run homer in the fifth inning gave Cleveland the lead for good in a 3-2 victory. It continued a breakout postseason for the 24-year-old rookie, who is batting .364 (4-for-11) with an .818 slugging percentage since moving into the lineup for the Guardians' win-or-go-home Game 5 against the Chicago White Sox on Saturday night. In one of the most improbable scenes in recent memory, Halpin unleashed a 25-foot-high bat flip after taking Griffin Jax deep Thursday -- and basked in chants of "Pe-tey" each time he came to the plate or fielded a ball the rest of the afternoon. "The bat flip was maybe a little much, if you ask me, but the moment was so exciting," said Guardians closer Cade Smith. "We're thrilled when stuff like that happens. It's so much fun. Guys are jumping around, giving high-fives, so it's a lot of fun." Cleveland's pitching plan has come together well for potential Games 6 and 7 on the road, which would see Parker Messick and postseason strikeout leader Gavin Williams go on normal rest. The Guardians will turn to right-hander Shawn Armstrong (0-0, 0.00) to start Game 4 as an opener. Armstrong allowed one hit over 1 2/3 scoreless innings in a no-decision against Tampa Bay on Tuesday. He was not as fortunate in his previous encounter with the Rays, permitting three runs on one hit in two-thirds of an inning in a no-decision on July 24 in an 11-3 loss. Armstrong, 36, has a 6.92 ERA without a decision in 15 career relief appearances versus the Rays. Tampa Bay is one of eight teams Armstrong has played for during his 12-season career. Tampa Bay, which won Game 2 at home, will hand the start to Nick Martinez on Friday. The 36-year-old right-hander pitched 3 2/3 innings and gave up two runs against the New York Yankees when he started Game 3 of the ALDS on Oct. 7. Martinez went 15-6 with a 3.10 ERA in the regular season over 31 starts, but Cash made him a bullpen option earlier in the ALCS. "The first game, I sat in the bullpen and didn't really like it," Martinez said, chuckling. "I was in the dugout with cleats on the second game. Whatever the team needs, I'm up for it. That's got to be my mentality for the rest of the year." Martinez pitched brilliantly against the Guardians during the regular season. He won both of his starts while permitting just seven hits and one walk over 13 scoreless innings. He added nine strikeouts as Cleveland's batters posted a .159/.178/.182 slash line against him. "We're just going to take it as we go, right?" Martinez said. "Not much you can control about that, so just be ready to go." Martinez is 3-2 with a 4.39 ERA in eight career appearances (four starts) versus Cleveland. --Brian Dulik, Field Level Media

item.title: Angola's fuel subsidies spending projected to hit $4 billion in 2026, official says
item.description: Angola could spend up to 3.8 trillion kwanzas ($4.16 billion) on fuel subsidies this year, nearly double its initial projections of less than 2 trillion kwanzas, a senior finance official told Reuters on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Rae Wee
item.content:encoded: Angola could spend up to 3.8 trillion kwanzas ($4.16 billion) on fuel subsidies this year, nearly double its initial projections of less than 2 trillion kwanzas, a senior finance official told Reuters on Friday. The increase underscores the fiscal strain facing the oil-producing nation, as surging energy prices from the ongoing war in the Middle East drive up the cost of keeping domestic fuel prices low. The mounting bill is adding pressure on the government to accelerate its gradual removal of subsidies, which began in 2023, but authorities are wary of moving too quickly for fear of economic and social fallout, Ottoniel dos Santos, Angola's secretary of state for finance and the treasury, told Reuters. "We need to move not only with the subsidies removal, but also with the diversification of our economy," said dos Santos in an interview on the sidelines of the annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank in Bangkok. "For now, it's been taken as it is - slowly," he added, referring to the scaling back of subsidies. "But if there is any window that could be used... and if we expect the impact on those who are more vulnerable are less than we forecast, then it will be easy to implement." The country now expects oil prices to average around $90 per barrel by the end of the year, higher than the reference price of $61 it used in its 2026 budget. Although the government has yet to submit its 2027 budget, due at the end of the month, dos Santos said its oil price assumption would not differ significantly from the International Monetary Fund's forecast of $71.50 a barrel. The government expects crude production to come in at 1.045 million barrels per day in 2027, matching this year's output. DIVERSIFYING FUNDING NEEDS Angola's $4 billion Eurobond issuance and other liability operations have covered the "majority" of the country's funding needs this year, dos Santos said, with any plans for further bond issuances or external financing dependent on the 2027 budget. "This is something that we will have to see what will be the needs for 2027 and identify if there is an opportunity or not for us to come back to the market," he told Reuters, adding that the country is [USN:L8N4510C2 TEXT:"actively opening up"] its domestic government bond market to foreign investors. The government is welcoming "all investors, all the regions" to buy Angolan debt, and is stepping up efforts to educate investors on access to its capital market. "Some investors think that the capital account is still closed, that it'll be difficult to get out when they get in, but actually it's not happening," said dos Santos. "We want to go everywhere, we want them to come as well... we want people to know that Angola is opening the domestic market to get opportunities from other investors, from other countries." ($1 = 913.0000 kwanzas)

item.title: Why CoreWeave is in the crosshairs of the AI scare
